what: Barrick Mining is one of the world's largest gold producers, with mines in Nevada, Africa, Latin America and Papua New Guinea. It also produces a significant amount of copper and is expanding that side.
customers: Refiners and bullion markets for gold; smelters and traders for copper.
money: production from mines in North America, Africa and Latin America
Lumwana in Zambia and Reko Diq in Pakistan
moat: Tier-one ore bodies with decades of reserves, including a joint venture over the Nevada gold complex with Newmont.
risks: Profit depends on the gold price, which it does not control
The dispute over its Mali operations removed production and remains unresolved
Operations in Pakistan, Zambia and Mali carry political risk
Mining cost inflation has squeezed margins industry-wide
opportunities: A high gold price lifted revenue about 31% in the last financial year
The Reko Diq copper project is one of the largest undeveloped deposits in the world
It holds more cash than debt, unusual among large miners
watch: All-in sustaining cost per ounce and progress on Reko Diq and the Mali dispute.
